slug: 2024-05-27 Benin Launches New Online Tax Services for Businesses and Property Owners

facts.fact: Benin's Directorate General of Taxes unveiled new online services on 23 May 2024 to streamline tax payments for small businesses and property owners in Cotonou, on the e-services.impots.bj portal first launched in 2017.

systems.tiers: small businesses and property owners in Cotonou, nationwide expansion planned
